script.es: Un salón tranquilo para tu mascota.
script.en: A calm salon for your pet.

parrafo.es: Canine Oasis The Natural Pet Salon atiende perros y gatos en Ocala. Baños, cortes completos, recorte de uñas y tratamiento de muda, en un espacio pequeño y silencioso donde tu mascota no se siente en una perrera ruidosa.
parrafo.en: Canine Oasis The Natural Pet Salon grooms dogs and cats in Ocala. Baths, full haircuts, nail trims and de-shed treatments, in a small, quiet space where your pet never feels like it walked into a noisy kennel.

hero.imagen_alt: Freshly groomed West Highland terrier standing on the grooming table at Canine Oasis The Natural Pet Salon

parrafo_1.es: Canine Oasis The Natural Pet Salon es un salón pequeño en Ocala dedicado al grooming de perros y gatos: baños, cortes completos, recorte de uñas y tratamiento de muda, en salas tranquilas pensadas para que tu mascota esté cómoda.
parrafo_1.en: Canine Oasis The Natural Pet Salon is a small Ocala salon dedicated to dog and cat grooming: baths, full haircuts, nail trims and de-shed treatments, in quiet rooms built to keep your pet comfortable.

parrafo_2.es: En las reseñas de Google los clientes repiten lo mismo: el lugar está impecable, no huele, y no se siente como una perrera ruidosa. Varios cuentan que sus mascotas, incluso las más nerviosas, salen relajadas y con un corte precioso.
parrafo_2.en: Clients keep saying the same thing in their Google reviews: the shop is immaculate, it does not smell, and it never feels like a loud kennel. Several say their pets, even the nervous ones, come out relaxed with a beautiful cut.

texto.es: Nos cuentas la raza y el tamaño de tu mascota y encontramos un horario que te sirva.
texto.en: Tell us your pet's breed and size and we will find a time that works for you.

texto.es: Tu mascota entra a un espacio pequeño y silencioso, sin jaulas ni perros ladrando sin parar.
texto.en: Your pet walks into a small, quiet space, no cages, no dogs barking out of control.

texto.es: Baño, corte y recorte de uñas con calma, a un ritmo adecuado para cada perro o gato.
texto.en: Bath, haircut and nail trim done calmly, at a pace that fits each dog or cat.

texto.es: Recoges a tu mascota limpia, bien cortada y relajada, tal como lo describen las reseñas.
texto.en: You pick up your pet clean, nicely trimmed and relaxed, just like the reviews describe.

nota.es: Cada servicio se cotiza según la raza, el tamaño y el estado del pelaje de tu mascota. Llama y te damos el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every service is quoted based on your pet's breed, size and coat condition. Call and we will give you a price, no obligation.

texto.es: Baño, secado, corte de pelo a tijera o máquina y acabado, igual a los perros y gatos que ves en nuestras fotos.
texto.en: Bath, blow dry, scissor or clipper haircut and finish, just like the dogs and cats you see in our photos.

texto.es: Baño con productos suaves, secado y cepillado a fondo para mascotas que no necesitan corte todavía.
texto.en: A bath with gentle products, blow dry and a thorough brush out for pets that do not need a haircut yet.

texto.es: Un servicio rápido y tranquilo para mantener las uñas y los oídos de tu mascota en buen estado.
texto.en: A quick, calm service to keep your pet's nails and ears in good shape.

texto.es: Para razas de pelaje denso que sueltan mucho pelo: un tratamiento pensado para reducir la muda en casa.
texto.en: For heavy-coated breeds that shed a lot, a treatment aimed at cutting down the shedding you deal with at home.

pie.es: ¿Tu mascota necesita algo distinto? Llama igual, seguro lo cubrimos.
pie.en: Does your pet need something else? Call anyway, we likely cover it.

items.quote: Rainey is the best groomer EVER! My dog loves her and she does a beautiful job. Thank you so much Rainey.
Rainny does such a great job with the fur babies. Her shop is immaculate, does not smell, and she is so sweet and wonderful with her "customers" and their parents too. I recommend her highly.

We brought our dog Henry here for a groom and couldn't be happier! Rainny was incredibly gentle and gave Henry the perfect haircut. The atmosphere is so loving and harmonious, making it a completely stress-free experience.

Rainey is awesome with our dog, and he absolutely loves her. He always comes home looking so handsome. What is nice about Canine Oasis is it doesn't feel like you're walking into a kennel where it is loud with dogs barking out of control.
